WITH large AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, o.amount, d.A3 AS region
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE o.amount > 2802
),
grp AS (
  SELECT account_id, region, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM large
  GROUP BY account_id, region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM grp
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS difference
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE g.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
